manifest.name: dsh-privacy-gateway
manifest.description: Process-wide HTTP redaction gateway for DSH: masks secrets in outgoing model requests and restores placeholders in the replies, for every provider.
manifest.author: xbzbing <xbzbing@gmail.com>

bundle.text:
# dsh-privacy-gateway — bundle patch: insert the plugin row.
#
# The loader imports the row's `name`, so it must equal this package's name.
# `id` is the settings namespace and the keyed config slot. Only this row is
# inserted; no built-in row's config is touched.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-privacy-gateway
      name: 'dsh-privacy-gateway'
      config: {}

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

在宿主进程的 undici 全局 dispatcher 上装一层脱敏网关。出站把模型请求体里的密钥换成占位符，入站把回流里的占位符换回真值。对 agent、adapter、provider 都无感，一处拦截覆盖所有走 `fetch()` 的 provider，包括插件提供的 adapter。

如果你在用**中转站**或者在处理**敏感信息**、**线上数据**，请务必注意保护信息安全。
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-privacy-gateway@latest

readme.section: 同一版本的 GitHub Release 附件（预发布也发在这里）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-privacy-gateway/releases/download/v0.1.4/dsh-privacy-gateway-0.1.4.tgz
```

预发布版本号带 `-`，只发 GitHub Release、不发 npm。仓库不提交 `lib/`，`dsh plugin add github:…` 拿到的树加载不了（[ADR-0006](docs/adr/0006-distribution-and-build-artifacts.md)）。

在默认的 web profile 里首次安装即装即用，无需重启 dsh 实例。通过 dsh web profile 的插件更新功能更新插件时，无需重启 dsh 实例。手动更新时建议先卸载旧版本再安装新版本，这样也不需要重启。

- **脱敏范围**：密钥、token、密码、私钥、cookie、邮箱、手机号、身份证、银行卡、自定义敏感词，各有开关。
- **动作可选**：按 kind 选 `mask` / `warn` / `block`，密钥可换成同形的假 key（`shape`）。
- **记录与统计**：按天落盘的脱敏记录、统计卡、会话「隐私保护」标签页；记录里只有占位符，没有真值。
- **`/privacy` 命令**：查状态、临时开关、`test` 预览一段文本会怎样发出。
- **配置热更新**：日常项在插件页上改，下一次调用即生效；脱敏出错时请求不发出。

| kind | 内容 | 开关 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `API_KEY` | OpenAI / Anthropic `sk-…`、GitHub / GitLab 令牌、Google `AIza…`、Slack `xox…`、Stripe、AWS `AKIA…`、阿里云 `LTAI…`、腾讯云 `AKID…`、Hugging Face、Groq、xAI、npm、PyPI、DigitalOcean、SendGrid 等前缀 | `secrets` |
| `TOKEN` | JWT | `secrets` |
| `PRIVATE_KEY` | PEM 私钥块 | `secrets` |
| `PASSWORD` / `SECRET` | URL 里的密码、名为 password / secret / token 的字段、中文「密码为…」「密钥是…」 | `secrets` |
| `COOKIE` | `Cookie` / `Set-Cookie` 头、`curl -b`、cookies.txt、Playwright storageState、HAR、常见会话 cookie 名（`BDUSS`、`JSESSIONID` 等） | `secrets` |
| `EMAIL` / `PHONE` / `ID_CARD` / `BANK_CARD` | 邮箱、大陆手机号、身份证号（校验位）、银行卡号（Luhn） | `personal` |
| `TERM` | 配置里 `words` 列出的词 | 有词就脱敏 |

脱敏过的值在请求的其它地方再出现，也按同一个占位符脱敏（finder 记为 `known`）。同一个 host 重发的历史保持原来的字节，prompt cache 照样命中。

照着试：下面每行都是**假值**，复制进会话发出去，统计卡的对应记录里就会出现替换后的占位符。记录、统计、日志和 vendorView 副本里都没有原值，只有占位符和首尾几个字符。

```text
sk-proj-Zq7Lr2Vt9mK1Px3aB5cD8eF0gH4jN6wY                             → API_KEY
ghp_Zq7Lr2Vt9mK1Px3aB5cD8eF0gH4jN6wYQ7RT2W                           → API_KEY
AKIAQ7RT2W9KLM4NP8XZ                                                 → API_KEY
Authorization: Bearer Zq7Lr2Vt9mK1Px3aB5cD8eF0gH4jN6wY9f2kLm4pQr7sT  → TOKEN

- 中文写法「密码：…」「密钥是 …」和 URL 里的密码记为 `{{PASSWORD_p7gqwtns}}`，和 `SECRET` 分开记。
- `EMAIL`、`PHONE`、`ID_CARD`、`BANK_CARD` 默认不换，打开「脱敏个人信息」才生效。
- 「自定义敏感词」里的词按词替换，记为 `TERM`；「永不脱敏的值」和 `allow` 里的原样发出。
- 私钥整段一起换：`-----BEGIN` 到 `-----END`，或只有开头一段 base64 的截断私钥。
- 文档域名（`example.com`、`.example`）不算邮箱；手机号要 11 位、身份证要过校验位、银行卡要过 Luhn，否则不换。
- 字段的值是一个文件名时不是密钥：只由文件名的字符组成、且扩展名是已知的文件类型（模型权重 `safetensors`/`gguf`/`ckpt` 等、压缩包、图片音视频、文档数据），原样发出（[ADR-0026](docs/adr/0026-file-name-values.md)）。
- 同一个值重复出现，占位符相同。
- 短于 8 个字符的秘密（`abc123`、`666666`、`888888` 这类口令）不算值：照原样发出，也不进记录。它们随时能被爆破，遮住只是给人一种并不存在的保护；值表本来也不把这么短的值当作已知值（[ADR-0031](docs/adr/0031-no-short-or-template-values.md)）。
- 明显是占位写法的值不算值：8 个以上相同字符连排（`sk-proj-xxxx…`、`AKIA0000…`），或自带「这是占位」说明（`your_api_key`、`example`、`changeme`、`placeholder`、`dummy`、`***`）。随机 key 出现 8 连排的概率低于十亿分之一，`sk_test_…` 这种真测试 key 照旧脱敏（[ADR-0031](docs/adr/0031-no-short-or-template-values.md)）。
- 加密算法的名字不算值：`SCRAM-SHA-512`、`PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256` 这类名字写在规范里、人人可读，遮住什么都不保护，原样发出（[ADR-0033](docs/adr/0033-algorithm-names.md)）。
- 键名和值一样脱敏：`{"metadata": {"sk-…": …}}` 里的键名也换成占位符，回复里再换回来；协议自身的键（`model`、`role`、`type`、`name`、`id` 等）、工具定义和工具调用的参数名不动（[ADR-0029](docs/adr/0029-mask-json-keys.md)）。

插件页面里本插件那一行的「配置」页上可以直接改日常项：`enabled`、`secrets`、`personal`、`shape`、`toolGuard`、`maskKeys`、`words`、`allow`、`record`、`keepDays`、`recordContext`、`vendorView`、`showPanel`、`excludeProviders`。改了即时保存，从下一次模型调用起生效，不用重启（[ADR-0021](docs/adr/0021-live-settings.md)）。其余项在 profile 的 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 里改，写在 `id: dsh-privacy-gateway` 那一行的 `config` 下；插件包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 升级时会被覆盖，不要改它。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后网关仍在，但所有请求原样放行，不还原、不记录 |
| `secrets` | `true` | 脱敏密钥、令牌、密码、私钥、cookie |
| `personal` | `false` | 脱敏邮箱、手机号、身份证号、银行卡号 |
| `words` | `[]` | 自己的词（项目代号、客户名），按原样换成 `TERM` 占位符 |
| `allow` | `[]` | 永不脱敏的值：整值匹配，不分大小写 |
| `actions` | `{}` | 按 kind 选动作：`mask`（默认，换成占位符）、`warn`（照发并记一条）、`block`（整个请求不发）。例：`{ PRIVATE_KEY: block, EMAIL: warn }`（[ADR-0013](docs/adr/0013-actions.md)） |
| `maskKeys` | `true` | 读起来像密钥或个人信息的 **JSON 键名**也换成占位符（`{"sk-…": …}`）；协议自身的键（`model`、`role`、`type`、`name`、`id` 等）、工具定义和工具调用的参数名永不动，否则供应商读不懂请求。关闭后这类键名原样发出（[ADR-0029](docs/adr/0029-mask-json-keys.md)） |
| `toolGuard` | `off` | 工具调用参数里还原出值、又指向本机以外的 host 时怎么办：`off` 只计数，`warn` 告警并记一条，`block` 这次调用的参数里不还原，工具拿到占位符（[ADR-0014](docs/adr/0014-tool-guard.md)） |
| `shape` | `false` | 密钥换成同形的假 key（前缀、长度、字符类别不变），而不是 `{{…}}` 占位符；不足 8 个字符、或含字母数字与 `-` `_` `.` 以外字符的值仍用占位符；回复里照样还原（[ADR-0015](docs/adr/0015-shape.md)） |
| `cookieNames` | `[]` | 追加要脱敏的 cookie 名 |
| `cookieKeep` | `['lang', 'locale', 'theme', 'tz']` | 永不脱敏的 cookie 名 |
| `protectEnvBlock` | `true` | `<env>` … `</env>` 块原样发出，供会校验它的 provider 使用（[ADR-0004](docs/adr/0004-protected-regions.md)） |
| `protectTools` | `tr

| 用法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/privacy` 或 `/privacy status` | 开关状态、值表大小、今日 / 7 天 / 30 天的请求与替换计数、按 kind 和 finder 的分布、异常信号 |
| `/privacy off` | 本次运行内停止脱敏，请求按原文发出；不改配置，重启后恢复 |
| `/privacy on` | 恢复脱敏 |
| `/privacy test <文本>` | 预览这段文本会怎样发出：脱敏后的文本和每个值的 kind、finder、开头、长度。不进值表，原文不写进会话日志 |

命令的回答里不出现任何值。

只记有脱敏或还原的模型请求，一个请求一条（既没脱敏也没还原的不记）：时间、脱敏耗时、host、model、会话 id 及其工作区名与会话标题、替换处数、每个值的占位符 / kind / finder / 开头 / 长度 / 结尾 / 出现过的每一处、这次请求所在的轮次与步数、值本次运行里首次被发出的轮次与步数、回复里还原的处数（工具调用参数里的另计），以及回复里出现、值表里却没有的占位符数。记录里不写值本身，也不记 URL 的 query（[ADR-0008](docs/adr/0008-masking-records.md)、[ADR-0020](docs/adr/0020-record-attribution.md)）。

「开头」保留的是辨识用的几个字符：有前缀的密钥留下前缀和它后面的 4 个，没有前缀的留前 4 个，长值再加末尾 2 个（`sk-proj-g6sx…3QaZ`），短值更少；个人信息和自定义词仍只留 1 个（[ADR-0019](docs/adr/0019-hint.md)）。

记录按天写在一个按天命名的 `masking/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`，目录 0700、文件 0600。状态放在当前实例自己的目录里（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/plugin-data/dsh-privacy-gateway/`），几个实例不会写到一起（[ADR-0027](docs/adr/0027-per-instance-state.md)）。写盘失败只告警，不影响请求。

插件详情页下方有一张统计卡：今日 / 7 天 / 30 天切换，计数、按 kind / finder / host 的分布、最近 200 条记录（每页 10 条，每条带着时间、这次请求在第几轮第几步发出（行上写作 `42·3`，与「轨迹」标签页的编号一致；窄屏隐藏，明细里写全「这次请求在第 42 轮 · 第 3 步发出」）、工作区 · 会话标题），点开一条看每个值的明细：值下面一行标出它出现在哪条消息（「用户消息 · `messages.3`」，3 是请求 body 里消息的下标，从 0 起算，和「查看发出内容」里看到的 body 对得上）和前后文字，同一个值在别处也出现过的，再一行列出其余的（「还出现在 `messages.7`、`messages.9`」，超过 8 处只说还有多少处），据此可以直接回到那段对话里核对：每个值下面还会写它本次运行里首次被发出的是第几轮第几步（重启后重新计），轮次和步数说这次请求是哪一步发出的，消息序号说值在那次请求的哪条消息里（记录里没有轮次步数的老记录、以及不在某一步里发出的请求，这一列留空）。注意它是**发出**的那一步：某一步的输出要到下一步的请求里才发出去，所以按值在轨迹里搜到的往往是更早一步，值下面标着「模型回复」就说明它来自更早的一条回复。卡片右上角的「清空数据」勾选确认后，删除所有会话的记录、统计和磁盘上的记录文件，无法恢复（[ADR-0022](docs/adr/0022-reset.md)）。打开 `showPanel` 后，同样的内容也出现在会话顶部的「隐私保护」标签页里，只统计当前会话。标签页头部的「本会话脱敏」开关可以只关掉这一个会话的脱敏，确认后生效，其他会话照常脱敏，重启后仍然保持（[ADR-0023](docs/adr/0023-session-switch.md)）。
打开 `vendorView`（配置页上叫「保留发出内容，供对照查看」）后，记录明细里多一个「查看发出内容」按钮，用来核对模型服务实际收到了什么、有没有漏脱敏：右边是模型服务收到的原文，左边是同一份内容里每个替换处换成「kind · 开头 · 长度」的标记，默认只列有替换的行。两边都不出现真值，warn 照发的值在副本里也换成了占位符。

- 会话日志里是真值：还原发生在日志落盘之前（[ADR-0003](docs/adr/0003-restore-before-session-log.md)）。会话同步、备份、分享带走的是真值。
- 覆盖面只有走全局 `fetch()` 的流量；`node:http` 直连、worker 线程、独立进程不经过网关（[ADR-0001](docs/adr/0001-intercept-at-undici-global-dispatcher.md)）。
- 压缩的请求与回复先解压再脱敏、还原；认不出的 `content-encoding` 不发（[ADR-0025](docs/adr/0025-compression-and-upgrades.md)）。模型调用里的 `upgrade` 握手（WebSocket）与 `CONNECT` 隧道也不发：Codex 第一次被拒后回落到 SSE，之后同一会话直接走 SSE；模型调用之外的升级与隧道（别的插件自己的连接，如 dsh-im-infoflow 的入站）放行，消息不脱敏，每个 host 提示一次（[ADR-0032](docs/adr/0032-upgrade-scoped-to-masked-calls.md)）——这是 fail-closed 往 fail-open 的取舍，代价见 ADR；需要整条链路放行的 host 仍可加进 `excludeHosts`。
- 值表只在内存里（[ADR-0009](docs/adr/0009-value-table-and-restore-exfiltration.md)）。重启后，规则命不中、只靠记忆兜住的值第一次出站会按原文发出。
- 还原发生在回复里，包括工具调用参数：模型被诱导把占位符写进 `curl` 之类的命令时，工具执行时用的是真值。插件只记账（统计卡与 `/privacy status` 里的「工具参数」计数），不拦截（[ADR-0009](docs/adr/0009-value-table-and-restore-exfiltration.md)）。
- 脱敏出错时请求不会发出，报错 `dsh-privacy-gateway: masking failed, request not sent`（[ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-fail-closed.md)）。止血办法是 `/privacy off`，或在插件页停用本插件、把配置 `enabled` 设为 `false`。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm verify   # typecheck + test
pnpm build    # 产出 lib/：host 半 index.js 与 client 半 client.js（不入库）
```

从本地目录安装前先 `pnpm build`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-privacy-gateway
```

CI 与发布见 [ADR-0007](docs/adr/0007-release-process.md) 和 [.github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md](.github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md)。

- 包名、cordis 行名、loader id、设置命名空间都是 `dsh-privacy-gateway`（行名必须等于包名）。
- 状态目录是当前实例自己的目录（`ctx.profileContext.dir` 下 `plugin-data/dsh-privacy-gateway/`），没有 profile 时退回 `~/.dsh/privacy-gateway/`；环境变量 `DSH_PRIVACY_GATEWAY_HOME` 优先于两者（[ADR-0027](docs/adr/0027-per-instance-state.md)）。
- 配置 schema 里不放 `.transform()` 或任何带回调的节点。
- `scripts` 里不挂安装期生命周期脚本。
- 其它 dispatcher 插件挂到网关下游时，按 [ADR-0012](docs/adr/0012-dispatcher-composition.md) 的合成契约（`chainTo`、`below`、`release`、`downstreams`）。
- 架构决策记在 [docs/adr/](docs/adr/README.md)。
- `README.en.md` 逐条跟随本文件。
脱敏功能的设计参考了 [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie)：占位符的生成与还原、规则表、JSON 中保留不动的字段、转义 JSON 的处理都沿用它的语义，代码用 TypeScript 重写。

A redaction gateway on the host process's undici global dispatcher. Secrets in outgoing model request bodies are replaced with placeholders, and placeholders in the replies are replaced back with the real values. The agent, adapters and providers don't notice it, and one interception point covers every provider that goes through `fetch()`, including adapters that plugins provide.
If you are using an **API relay**, or you are working with **sensitive information** or **production data**, please be sure to protect information security.
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-privacy-gateway@latest

dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-privacy-gateway/releases/download/v0.1.4/dsh-privacy-gateway-0.1.4.tgz
```

A prerelease version has a `-` in it and goes to GitHub Releases only, never to npm. The repository does not commit `lib/`, so `dsh plugin add github:…` cannot load the plugin ([ADR-0006](docs/adr/0006-distribution-and-build-artifacts.md)).

readme.text: In the default web profile the first install works at once, with no restart of the dsh instance. Updating the plugin through the dsh web profile's plugin update feature needs no restart of the dsh instance either. When updating by hand, uninstall the old version before installing the new one, and that needs no restart either.

- **What is masked**: keys, tokens, passwords, private keys, cookies, email addresses, phone numbers, ID card and bank card numbers, and your own words — each with its own switch.
- **Actions**: pick `mask` / `warn` / `block` per kind; a key can be sent as a made-up key of its own form (`shape`).
- **Records and statistics**: records written to disk by the day, a statistics card, and the session's 「隐私保护」 (Privacy) tab; a record holds placeholders, never a value.
- **The `/privacy` command**: status, a temporary on / off, and `test` to preview how a text would go out.
- **Live configuration**: everyday items are changed on the plugin page and apply from the next call; when masking fails, the request is not sent.

| Kind | What | Switch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `API_KEY` | OpenAI / Anthropic `sk-…`, GitHub / GitLab tokens, Google `AIza…`, Slack `xox…`, Stripe, AWS `AKIA…`, Alibaba Cloud `LTAI…`, Tencent Cloud `AKID…`, Hugging Face, Groq, xAI, npm, PyPI, DigitalOcean, SendGrid and other prefixes | `secrets` |
| `TOKEN` | JWTs | `secrets` |
| `PRIVATE_KEY` | PEM private key blocks | `secrets` |
| `PASSWORD` / `SECRET` | Passwords in URLs, fields named password / secret / token, Chinese phrases such as 「密码为…」「密钥是…」 | `secrets` |
| `COOKIE` | `Cookie` / `Set-Cookie` headers, `curl -b`, cookies.txt, Playwright storageState, HAR, common session cookie names (`BDUSS`, `JSESSIONID` and others) | `secrets` |
| `EMAIL` / `PHONE` / `ID_CARD` / `BANK_CARD` | Email addresses, mainland China mobile numbers, ID card numbers (check digit), bank card numbers (Luhn) | `personal` |
| `TERM` | The words listed in the `words` config | whenever there are words |

A value masked once is masked with the same placeholder wherever else the request has it (its finder is `known`). History sent to the same host again keeps the bytes it went with before, so the prompt cache still hits.

To try it: every line below is a **fake** value; paste one into a session and the matching record on the card shows the placeholder it became. Neither the records, the stats, the log nor the vendorView copy holds the value, only the placeholder and a few characters at each end.

```text
sk-proj-Zq7Lr2Vt9mK1Px3aB5cD8eF0gH4jN6wY                             → API_KEY
ghp_Zq7Lr2Vt9mK1Px3aB5cD8eF0gH4jN6wYQ7RT2W                           → API_KEY
AKIAQ7RT2W9KLM4NP8XZ                                                 → API_KEY
Authorization: Bearer Zq7Lr2Vt9mK1Px3aB5cD8eF0gH4jN6wY9f2kLm4pQr7sT  → TOKEN

- The Chinese wordings 「密码：…」 and 「密钥是 …」, and a password in a URL, are recorded as `{{PASSWORD_p7gqwtns}}`, apart from `SECRET`.
- `EMAIL`, `PHONE`, `ID_CARD` and `BANK_CARD` are off until 「脱敏个人信息」 is on.
- A word in 「自定义敏感词」 is replaced where it appears and recorded as `TERM`; a value in 「永不脱敏的值」 or `allow` goes out as it is.
- A private key goes whole: `-----BEGIN` to `-----END`, or a truncated one with only the opening lines and base64.
- A documentation domain (`example.com`, `.example`) is no email; a phone number needs 11 digits, an ID card its check digit, a bank card its Luhn sum.
- A field's value is no secret when it is a file's name: only a file name's characters, and an extension of a known kind (model weights such as `safetensors`, `gguf`, `ckpt`, archives, pictures, sound and video, documents and data); it goes out as it is ([ADR-0026](docs/adr/0026-file-name-values.md)).
- One value seen again gets the same placeholder.
- A secret shorter than 8 characters (`abc123`, `666666`, `888888`: a short password) is no value: it goes as written and makes no record. It is guessed in no time, so masking it only promises a protection that is not there — and the value table neve

No answer of the command has a value in it.

Only a model request that had something masked or restored makes a record, one each (a request with neither makes none): the time, how long masking took, the host, the model, the session id with its workspace name and session title, the places replaced, each value's placeholder / kind / finder / head / length / tail / every place it was at, the turn and step the request was sent in, the turn and step it was first sent in this run, the places the reply had restored (with those in tool call arguments counted apart), and the placeholders the reply had that the value table has no value for. A record never holds a value, nor a URL's query ([ADR-0008](docs/adr/0008-masking-records.md), [ADR-0020](docs/adr/0020-record-attribution.md)).

The head keeps a few characters to recognize it by: a key with a prefix keeps the prefix and the 4 characters after it, one without keeps its first 4, and a long value also keeps its last 2 (`sk-proj-g6sx…3QaZ`); shorter values keep fewer. Personal data and the user's words still keep one character ([ADR-0019](docs/adr/0019-hint.md)).

Records go to a `masking/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`, one file a day; the directory is 0700 and the files 0600. State lives in the current instance's own directory (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/plugin-data/dsh-privacy-gateway/`), so two instances never write into each other ([ADR-0027](docs/adr/0027-per-instance-state.md)). A failed write is logged as a warning and the request goes on.

The plugin's detail page has a statistics card at the bottom: today / 7 days / 30 days, the counts, the distributions by kind / finder / host, and the latest 200 records, 10 a page, each with its time, the turn and step its request went out in (written `42·3` on the row, numbered as the 「轨迹」, Trajectory, tab numbers them; hidden on a narrow screen, where the details say 「这次请求在第 42 轮 · 第 3 步发出」, this request went out in turn 42, step 3) and its workspace · session title; open one to see each of its values, a line under it naming the message it went in (「用户消息 · `messages.3`」, a user message, with its path; the 3 is the message's index in the request body, counted from 0, the same as in 「查看发出内容」, what was sent) and the text around it, then, where the same value was sent again, another line with the other places (「还出现在 `messages.7`、`messages.9`」, also at those; the places past the eighth are counted, not listed), so the conversation can be found and checked: each value also says which turn and step it was first sent in during this run (counted afresh after a restart), and the turn and step of the record say which step the request went out in, the message index says which message of tha

With `vendorView` on (「保留发出内容，供对照查看」, Keep what was sent to compare, on the Configure page), a record's details have a 「查看发出内容」 (What was sent) button, to check what the model service actually got and whether anything slipped through: on the right the body as the model service got it, on the left the same body with each replaced place shown as a "kind · head · length" marker; by default only the lines with replacements are listed. Neither side has a value in it; a value a warn action sent as written is a placeholder in the copy too.

- The session log holds the real values: replies are restored before the log is written ([ADR-0003](docs/adr/0003-restore-before-session-log.md)). Session sync, backups and shares carry the real values.
- Only traffic through the global `fetch()` is covered; direct `node:http`, worker threads and separate processes bypass the gateway ([ADR-0001](docs/adr/0001-intercept-at-undici-global-dispatcher.md)).
- Compressed requests and replies are decompressed before they are masked or restored; a `content-encoding` with no decoder fails the request ([ADR-0025](docs/adr/0025-compression-and-upgrades.md)). An upgrade (the WebSocket handshake) or a `CONNECT` tunnel inside a model call is refused as well: Codex falls back to SSE the first time and takes SSE from then on in that session. One opened by a plugin outside a model call (dsh-im-infoflow's inbound, say) is let through, its messages unmasked, with one warning per host ([ADR-0032](docs/adr/0032-upgrade-scoped-to-masked-calls.md)) — a fail-closed to fail-open trade whose cost the ADR records; a host that needs a transparent link can still go into `excludeHosts`.
- The value table is in memory only ([ADR-0009](docs/adr/0009-value-table-a

pnpm install
pnpm verify   # typecheck + test

```

Run `pnpm build` before installing from a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-privacy-gateway
```

For CI and releases see [ADR-0007](docs/adr/0007-release-process.md) and [.github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md](.github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md).

- The package name, cordis row name, loader id and settings namespace are all `dsh-privacy-gateway` (the row name must equal the package name).
- State lives in the current instance's own directory (`plugin-data/dsh-privacy-gateway/` under `ctx.profileContext.dir`), falling back to `~/.dsh/privacy-gateway/` when there is no profile; the `DSH_PRIVACY_GATEWAY_HOME` environment variable wins over both ([ADR-0027](docs/adr/0027-per-instance-state.md)).
- The config schema holds no `.transform()` or other callback-bearing node.
- `scripts` declares no install-time lifecycle script.
- Other dispatcher plugins join under the gateway through the composition contract of [ADR-0012](docs/adr/0012-dispatcher-composition.md) (`chainTo`, `below`, `release`, `downstreams`).
- Architecture decisions are recorded in [docs/adr/](docs/adr/README.md).
- `README.en.md` follows `README.md` item by item.

The redaction design follows [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie): how placeholders are made and restored, the rule table, the JSON fields left untouched, and the handling of escaped JSON keep its semantics, rewritten in TypeScript.
